    publish_results any When applicants learn the allocation decision: immediately, or for every proposal of a round together when a call manager publishes the round's results. Cannot be changed while decisions are held.
    resource_template_selection_mode any Whether a proposal may request several of the call's resource templates or at most one of them. Cannot be set to single while a draft proposal holds several resource requests.
    project_name_template string Name given to the project an accepted proposal creates. Placeholders: {proposal_name}, {proposal_slug}, {call_prefix}, {call_slug}, {call_name}, {round_start}, {round_slug}, {org_slug}, {year}. Empty means {call_prefix} - {round_start} - {proposal_name}.

    user_email_patterns array of strings List of email regex patterns. User must match one.
    user_affiliations array of strings List of allowed affiliations. User must have one.
    user_identity_sources array of strings List of allowed identity sources (identity providers).
    user_nationalities array of strings List of allowed nationality codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). User must have one.
    user_organization_types array of strings List of allowed organization type URNs (SCHAC). User must match one.
    user_assurance_levels array of strings List of required assurance URIs (REFEDS). User must have ALL of these.
    applicant_visibility_config any

    proposal_field_metadata.locked_reason string
    proposal_field_metadata.usage array of strings

    order_author any Whose name the orders for resources granted by this call carry.
    order_author_user string (uuid) The person orders are attributed to when the author is a named contact. Must hold a role on this call or on the organization managing it.
    order_author_user_uuid string (uuid)
    order_author_user_name string
    carry_over_drafts boolean Whether a draft still open when its round's cut-off passes moves on to the call's next round instead of being canceled. Without a later round the draft is canceled either way.
    coi_declaration_text string The conflict-of-interest declaration evaluators confirm, for every step asking them to that has no text of its own. Empty for the platform's standard declaration.
    undecided_at_round_completion any What completing a round does with its proposals that still have no decision: refuse to complete the round, or reject them. A round may override it.
    adoption_required boolean Whether a round's results must be adopted (by a board, say) before they are published. The adoption is then recorded while the round is deciding, and publication waits for it.
    budget_enforcement any How the allocation decision is held to the call's resource budgets. soft: approving an award past what remains needs an explicit override with a reason. hard: such an award is refused, and only staff may override it with a reason. Changing it affects only later decisions.
    applicant_cc_roles array of strings Names of the proposal roles whose holders are copied (Cc) on every mail to the applicant about a proposal: PROPOSAL.MANAGER for the principal investigator, PROPOSAL.ADMIN for the proposal administrators. Only the proposal's current team is copied. Empty copies nobody.
    target_decision_days integer Days from a round's cut-off to its decision the workflow is planned for, when the round has no allocation date. The workflow check compares the steps' durations with it.
    template_uuid string (uuid)
    template_name string
    template_version integer Version of the template the call was created from.
    template_latest_version integer The template's current version.

    Any signed-in user.

    Users with the staff or support flag see every call, whatever their token's scopes, as does a site-wide CALL.LIST grant. Anyone else sees the calls of organizations where they hold CALL.LIST, those of call managing organisations where they hold a role, and the calls they hold a role on, such as call manager or reviewer.

    evaluation_start any When a submitted proposal's evaluation starts: on submission, or for all proposals of a round together at its cut-off. Cannot be changed while the call has proposals submitted or in review.
    publish_results any When applicants learn the allocation decision: immediately, or for every proposal of a round together when a call manager publishes the round's results. Cannot be changed while decisions are held.
    resource_template_selection_mode any Whether a proposal may request several of the call's resource templates or at most one of them. Cannot be set to single while a draft proposal holds several resource requests.
    project_name_template string Name given to the project an accepted proposal creates. Placeholders: {proposal_name}, {proposal_slug}, {call_prefix}, {call_slug}, {call_name}, {round_start}, {round_slug}, {org_slug}, {year}. Empty means {call_prefix} - {round_start} - {proposal_name}.

    panel_vice_chair_uuid string (uuid)
    panel_vice_chair_name string
    proposal_slug_template string Template for proposal slugs. Supports: {call_slug}, {round_slug}, {org_slug}, {year}, {month}, {counter}, {counter_padded}. Default: {round_slug}-{counter_padded}
    user_email_patterns array of strings List of email regex patterns. User must match one.
    user_affiliations array of strings List of allowed affiliations. User must have one.
    user_identity_sources array of strings List of allowed identity sources (identity providers).
    user_nationalities array of strings List of allowed nationality codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). User must have one.
    user_organization_types array of strings List of allowed organization type URNs (SCHAC). User must match one.
    user_assurance_levels array of strings List of required assurance URIs (REFEDS). User must have ALL of these.
    applicant_visibility_config any
    reviewer_eligibility any Who may review for the call: checked when a reviewer is invited, accepts, is suggested or is given the call's reviewer role. Kept apart from the restrictions on applicants.

    proposal_field_metadata.field string
    proposal_field_metadata.state string
    Enum: hidden, optional, required
    proposal_field_metadata.allowed_states array of strings
    proposal_field_metadata.locked_reason string
    proposal_field_metadata.usage array of strings
    has_proposals boolean Whether any proposal has been submitted to this call. Used by the frontend to gate slug-template and checklist fields.
    order_author any Whose name the orders for resources granted by this call carry.
    order_author_user string (uuid) The person orders are attributed to when the author is a named contact. Must hold a role on this call or on the organization managing it.
    order_author_user_uuid string (uuid)
    order_author_user_name string
    carry_over_drafts boolean Whether a draft still open when its round's cut-off passes moves on to the call's next round instead of being canceled. Without a later round the draft is canceled either way.
    coi_declaration_text string The conflict-of-interest declaration evaluators confirm, for every step asking them to that has no text of its own. Empty for the platform's standard declaration.
    undecided_at_round_completion any What completing a round does with its proposals that still have no decision: refuse to complete the round, or reject them. A round may override it.
    adoption_required boolean Whether a round's results must be adopted (by a board, say) before they are published. The adoption is then recorded while the round is deciding, and publication waits for it.
    budget_enforcement any How the allocation decision is held to the call's resource budgets. soft: approving an award past what remains needs an explicit override with a reason. hard: such an award is refused, and only staff may override it with a reason. Changing it affects only later decisions.
    applicant_cc_roles array of strings Names of the proposal roles whose holders are copied (Cc) on every mail to the applicant about a proposal: PROPOSAL.MANAGER for the principal investigator, PROPOSAL.ADMIN for the proposal administrators. Only the proposal's current team is copied. Empty copies nobody.
    target_decision_days integer Days from a round's cut-off to its decision the workflow is planned for, when the round has no allocation date. The workflow check compares the steps' durations with it.
    template_uuid string (uuid)
    template_name string
    template_version integer Version of the template the call was created from.
    template_latest_version integer The template's current version.

    Any signed-in user.

    Users with the staff or support flag see every call, whatever their token's scopes, as does a site-wide CALL.LIST grant. Anyone else sees the calls of organizations where they hold CALL.LIST, those of call managing organisations where they hold a role, and the calls they hold a role on, such as call manager or reviewer.

    from waldur_api_client.client import AuthenticatedClient
from waldur_api_client.models.protected_call_request import ProtectedCallRequest # (1)
from waldur_api_client.api.proposal_protected_calls import proposal_protected_calls_create # (2)

client = AuthenticatedClient(
    base_url="https://api.example.com", token="YOUR_API_TOKEN"
)

body_data = ProtectedCallRequest(
    name="my-awesome-proposal-protected-call",
    manager="https://api.example.com/api/manager/a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890/"
)
response = proposal_protected_calls_create.sync(
    client=client,
    body=body_data
)

print(response)

});

    rounds.days_in_current_stage number (double) Days since the round entered its current stage, to now. Empty for a closed round, one not open yet, and one of a call not active.

    Any of:

    • Global support, for reads.
    • Requires CALL.UPDATE on the object or its manager.

    Enum: fixed, usage, limit, one, few
    requested_offering_components.type string Unique internal name of the measured unit, for example floating_ip.
    requested_offering_components.name string Display name for the measured unit, for example, Floating IP.
    requested_offering_components.description string
    requested_offering_components.measured_unit string Unit of measurement, for example, GB.
    requested_offering_components.unit_factor integer The conversion factor from backend units to measured_unit
    requested_offering_components.limit_period any
    requested_offering_components.limit_amount number (double)
    requested_offering_components.limit_decimal_places integer Number of decimal places accepted for this component's limit. 0 keeps the limit integer-only.
    requested_offering_components.article_code string
    requested_offering_components.max_value number (double)
    requested_offering_components.min_value number (double)
    requested_offering_components.max_available_limit number (double)
    requested_offering_components.is_boolean boolean
    requested_offering_components.default_limit number (double)
    requested_offering_components.spending_limit_periods object (free-form) Periods (day, week, month, quarter, year, total) for which customers can set a spending limit on this usage-based component; total counts all the usage since the resource started and never resets. Day and week need the integration to report usage per day. Empty when customers cannot set spending limits.
    requested_offering_components.factor integer
    requested_offering_components.is_builtin boolean The API's older name for billed_per_plan. It used to ask the plugin registry whether this component's type is one the plugin declares, which left out the OpenStack per-volume-type quotas: they are created by the volume type sync rather than declared, so the API called them provider components while the billing resolver treated them as builtin. Reading the stored flag makes the two agree.
    requested_offering_components.is_prepaid boolean
    requested_offering_components.overage_component string (uuid)
    requested_offering_components.min_prepaid_duration integer
    requested_offering_components.max_prepaid_duration integer
    requested_offering_components.prepaid_duration_step integer Step size in months for the initial prepaid duration at order creation. If set, only multiples of this value (starting from min_prepaid_duration) are valid. Defaults to 1 (any value between min and max).
    requested_offering_components.min_renewal_duration integer Minimum number of months allowed for a renewal.
    requested_offering_components.max_renewal_duration integer Maximum number of months allowed for a renewal.
    requested_offering_components.renewal_duration_step integer Step size in months for renewal. Only multiples of this value (starting from min_renewal_duration) are valid. Defaults to 1.
    created_by string (uri)
    created_by_name string
    created string (date-time)

    Any signed-in user.

    Users with the staff or support flag see every call, whatever their token's scopes, as does a site-wide CALL.LIST grant. Anyone else sees the calls of organizations where they hold CALL.LIST, those of call managing organisations where they hold a role, and the calls they hold a role on, such as call manager or reviewer.

    200 -

    The response body is an array of objects, where each object has the following structure:

    Field Type Description
    uuid string (uuid)
    created string (date-time)
    modified string (date-time)
    key string Identifier of the step within its call. Derived from the name when left out. Cannot change once the step exists.
    step string Deprecated alias of key.
    kind any Behavior of the step; see the workflow_step_kinds endpoint. Required unless the key is one of the default steps. Cannot change once the step exists.
    name string
    description string
    order integer Position in the call's workflow. A step already there, and every step after it, moves one down. Appended when left out.
    outcome_set any Outcomes the step can be completed with; one of its kind's outcome sets. The kind's default when left out.
    allowed_outcomes array of strings Outcomes the step can be completed with.
    on_negative any What a negative outcome does to the proposal.
    call_uuid string (uuid)
    call_name string
    is_enabled boolean Whether this step is enabled. Disabled steps are skipped.
    is_mandatory boolean
    is_allocation_decision boolean The decision step that settles the award. A call is activated with exactly one enabled.
    duration_in_days integer Duration in days. Used to calculate deadlines.
    checklist string (uuid)
    checklist_name string
    checklist_required boolean When the step has a checklist, block completion until its required questions are answered. Set False to make the checklist advisory.
    blind_review boolean Evaluators cannot see each other's assessments.
    requires_coi_confirmation boolean Evaluator must confirm absence of conflict of interest.
    coi_declaration_text string The conflict-of-interest declaration this step's evaluators confirm; empty for the call's, or the platform's standard one.
    contributor_source string Who contributes to the step, each with a contribution of their own: none, requested_offering_team, assigned_reviewers, proposal_role: or call_role:<call_manager
    contributor_proposal_role_uuid string (uuid) The evaluator role the contributor source names, when it names one.
    delegable_proposal_role_uuid string (uuid) The evaluator role delegable_to names, when it names one: its holders on the proposal can be handed a slot.
    per_requested_offering boolean One contribution per offering the proposal requests, which any member of that offering's team may fill.
    contributors_lead_only boolean Only the lead of the evaluator role the contributor source names contributes: one slot, the lead's, which moves when the lead changes. The step waits while the role has no lead.
    delegable_to string Who a contribution slot of the step can be handed to by its holder or the call's managers: empty for nobody, offering_team for anyone with a role on the slot's own offering (per-offering steps), or proposal_role: for the holders of an evaluator role on the proposal (per-person steps). The person it is handed to accepts or declines it.
    min_contributions integer Minimum contributions submitted before the step can complete. On a step without contributors, the minimum of the proposal's submitted reviews.
    max_contributions integer Most contributions the step accepts; no limit when empty.
    min_reviewers integer Deprecated alias of min_contributions.
    min_score_threshold string (decimal) Minimum average score required before this step can complete with any outcome but declined (a completion gate; it does not auto-reject lower scores). A step with contributors scores its own submitted reviews. A step without contributors that reads input steps takes the score of the latest completed input step that has one: the average of its reviews, else of the rating answers in its checklists. Otherwise all the proposal's submitted reviews count.
    applicant_visible boolean Whether the applicant can see step details (not just status).
    completer any Role expected to complete this step.
    responsible_role any Deprecated alias of completer.
    completer_proposal_role string (uuid) The call's evaluator role whose holders complete the step; required when the completer is proposal_role.
    completer_proposal_role_name string
    assigns_roles array of string (uuid)s Assignment step: the call's evaluator roles whose holders the completer picks, such as a lead and a second rapporteur.
    assigns_roles_names array of strings
    input_steps array of string (uuid)s Earlier steps of the call whose outputs this step's contributors and completer read; on an applicant step, whose public parts the applicant reads.
    input_steps_names array of strings
    contributors_warning string Why the call cannot give the step the contributions it needs: the evaluator role, call role or reviewer pool it takes them from has fewer people than its minimum. Null when it can.
    release_to_applicant boolean Assessment step: once completed, its report can be released to the applicant, such as a consolidated report or final feedback.
    collects_reviewer_suggestions boolean Assessment step of evaluator-role holders: each holder may suggest reviewers for the proposal while the step is active. The call's managers turn suggestions into pool invitations.
    allows_change_requests boolean Whoever acts on the step may send the proposal back to the applicant to change the parts they unlock, as often as needed. The proposal stays in review on the step meanwhile. Not for the allocation decision nor an applicant step.
    allows_conditional_acceptance boolean Per-offering assessment: a contribution may accept a requested offering under conditions. Off, it accepts or rejects it.
    transition_mode any How this step advances once a human completes it. 'Automatic' advances to the next step immediately; 'Manual' waits for a separate advance action. Neither auto-decides from review scores.
    run_condition any When the step runs: empty to run on every proposal; the key of an earlier step and the outcomes of it, or of its contributions, on which it runs; or the key of an earlier step and "score_spread_above": the points by which the highest and lowest scores its contributions gave must differ for the step to run. A proposal on which it does not hold skips the step. Fixed for a proposal when it is submitted.
    run_condition_step_name string Name of the step the run condition names, for display; null without a condition.
    parallel_with_previous boolean Start together with the step before it, as one stage: every step of a stage starts at once, and the next stage starts when all of them have ended.
    round_scoped boolean Run the step once per round rather than per proposal, such as a panel meeting after the cut-off: the call's managers open it for the round's proposals together, its contributors write one round report each covering their proposals, and it is completed for the round, never on one proposal.
    phase any When the step runs: in the evaluation, from submission to the award; in an extension, which the applicant of an accepted proposal asks for as often as needed; or in the closing, the final report at the end of the allocation. A phase's steps run in their order, each extension and closing in a run of its own.
    project_end_offset_days integer First step of an extension or closing phase: days before the project's end date. An extension can be asked for until then; the closing opens then (0: on the end date).
    status_labels any What each audience's dashboard calls the step, as entered: per audience, while active, once completed, per outcome and while changes are requested. Left out, the computed label stays.
    include_award_response boolean Allocation decision: require applicant award response after decision.
    decides_automatically boolean Allocation decision: approve on reaching this step, as the system, with the award as requested; fall back to the completer when the approval is refused.
    automatic_decision_guard any Automatic decision: what stops an unsuitable proposal -- an enabled earlier step that can reject it (earlier_step), or a person at the provider acting on every order the award places, on every accepted offering of the call (provider_fulfilment).
    allocation_time any Allocation decision: when a granted proposal takes effect — immediately (on_decision) or on the round's allocation date (fixed_date).
    display_order integer Deprecated: steps are ordered by order.
    criteria array of objects
    criteria.uuid string (uuid)
    criteria.name string
    criteria.order integer
    criteria.weight integer The criterion's weight in a review's overall score, relative to the other criteria of the step.
    criteria_locked boolean Whether reviewers have scored the step's criteria or submitted a review in it. Its criteria can then be reordered, not changed.
    notification_rules array of objects
    notification_rules.uuid string (uuid)
    notification_rules.trigger any
    notification_rules.recipient any
    notification_rules.days_before integer Only for deadline_approaching: how many days before the step's deadline the reminder is sent.
    notification_rules.is_enabled boolean
    notification_rules.notified_proposal_roles array of strings
    notification_rules.proposal_role string (uuid)
    notification_rules.proposal_role_name string
    responsible_users array of objects
    responsible_users.uuid string (uuid)
    responsible_users.username string
    responsible_users.full_name string
    responsible_users.email string (email)
    responsible_users.is_panel_chair boolean
    responsible_users.is_panel_vice_chair boolean
    responsible_users.offerings array of objects The offerings accepted into the call that the user manages; empty unless the user takes part as an offering manager.
    responsible_users.offerings.uuid string (uuid)
    responsible_users.offerings.name string
    responsible_users.offerings.customer_uuid string (uuid)
    contributing_users array of objects Who the contributor source names on the call: the holders of the call role it names, the reviewers who accepted to join the reviewer pool, or the managers of the offerings accepted into the call. Empty for an evaluator role, which is held per proposal.
    contributing_users.uuid string (uuid)
    contributing_users.username string
    contributing_users.full_name string

    contributing_users.is_panel_chair boolean
    contributing_users.is_panel_vice_chair boolean
    contributing_users.offerings array of objects The offerings accepted into the call that the user manages; empty unless the user takes part as an offering manager.
    contributing_users.offerings.uuid string (uuid)
    contributing_users.offerings.name string
    contributing_users.offerings.customer_uuid string (uuid)

    resource_templates.requested_offering_components.min_renewal_duration integer Minimum number of months allowed for a renewal.
    resource_templates.requested_offering_components.max_renewal_duration integer Maximum number of months allowed for a renewal.
    resource_templates.requested_offering_components.renewal_duration_step integer Step size in months for renewal. Only multiples of this value (starting from min_renewal_duration) are valid. Defaults to 1.

    resource_templates.created_by_name string
    resource_templates.created string (date-time)

    component_rules.uuid string (uuid)
    component_rules.requested_offering_uuid string (uuid)
    component_rules.component_type string Type of the offering component: one billed by its limit that the call offering's plan prices.
    component_rules.measured_unit string

    component_rules.max_per_proposal number (double)
    component_rules.default_amount number (double)
    component_rules.is_fixed boolean Every proposal requests exactly default_amount; the applicant cannot change it.
    fixed_duration_in_days integer
    allowed_duration_months array of integers Durations, in months, the applicant chooses the project's length from. Empty offers no choice. Cannot be combined with fixed_duration_in_days. Proposals already submitted keep the length they asked for.
    max_prepaid_duration_months integer The longest prepaid subscription, in whole months, that fits inside fixed_duration_in_days measured from today; null when the call fixes no duration.

    reviews_visible_to_submitters boolean Whether proposal applicants can see review comments and scores. Applicants still see what an applicant step lists as its input steps, such as the reviews they respond to.
    has_eligibility_restrictions boolean Check if call has any eligibility restrictions configured.

    Enum: hidden, optional, required

    Enum: hidden, optional, required
    proposal_field_config.field_supporting_documentation string
    Enum: hidden, optional, required
    evaluation_start any When a submitted proposal's evaluation starts: on submission, or for all proposals of a round together at its cut-off. Cannot be changed while the call has proposals submitted or in review.
    publish_results any When applicants learn the allocation decision: immediately, or for every proposal of a round together when a call manager publishes the round's results. Cannot be changed while decisions are held.
    resource_template_selection_mode any Whether a proposal may request several of the call's resource templates or at most one of them. Cannot be set to single while a draft proposal holds several resource requests.
    project_name_template string Name given to the project an accepted proposal creates. Placeholders: {proposal_name}, {proposal_slug}, {call_prefix}, {call_slug}, {call_name}, {round_start}, {round_slug}, {org_slug}, {year}. Empty means {call_prefix} - {round_start} - {proposal_name}.

    user_email_patterns array of strings List of email regex patterns. User must match one.
    user_affiliations array of strings List of allowed affiliations. User must have one.

    user_nationalities array of strings List of allowed nationality codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). User must have one.
    user_organization_types array of strings List of allowed organization type URNs (SCHAC). User must match one.
    user_assurance_levels array of strings List of required assurance URIs (REFEDS). User must have ALL of these.

    order_author_user_uuid string (uuid)

    carry_over_drafts boolean Whether a draft still open when its round's cut-off passes moves on to the call's next round instead of being canceled. Without a later round the draft is canceled either way.
    coi_declaration_text string The conflict-of-interest declaration evaluators confirm, for every step asking them to that has no text of its own. Empty for the platform's standard declaration.
    undecided_at_round_completion any What completing a round does with its proposals that still have no decision: refuse to complete the round, or reject them. A round may override it.
    adoption_required boolean Whether a round's results must be adopted (by a board, say) before they are published. The adoption is then recorded while the round is deciding, and publication waits for it.
    budget_enforcement any How the allocation decision is held to the call's resource budgets. soft: approving an award past what remains needs an explicit override with a reason. hard: such an award is refused, and only staff may override it with a reason. Changing it affects only later decisions.
    applicant_cc_roles array of strings Names of the proposal roles whose holders are copied (Cc) on every mail to the applicant about a proposal: PROPOSAL.MANAGER for the principal investigator, PROPOSAL.ADMIN for the proposal administrators. Only the proposal's current team is copied. Empty copies nobody.
    target_decision_days integer Days from a round's cut-off to its decision the workflow is planned for, when the round has no allocation date. The workflow check compares the steps' durations with it.

    template_name string

Day and week need the integration to report usage per day. Empty when customers cannot set spending limits.

It used to ask the plugin registry whether this component's type is one the plugin declares, which left out the OpenStack per-volume-type quotas: they are created by the volume type sync rather than declared, so the API called them provider components while the billing resolver treated them as builtin.     Allocate in submission order

    Take the allocation decision of every proposal of an ended round at it, first come first served: in submission order, approve each while its award fits what remains of every budget it draws on; decline those below the decision's quality threshold, and those that no longer fit (or leave them, on_depleted=leave) -- a later, smaller proposal still gets its chance. With preview (the default) only the plan is returned. Refused while a proposal of the round has not reached the decision, unless forced with a reason (the refusal carries waiting_count). Proposals the caller applies with or has a conflict of interest with are skipped. Each decision is taken on its own as if taken on the proposal; one that fails is listed in failed.

    Complete

    Close a round whose results have been published. Refused while a decision of the round is still held because its release failed (the refusal carries held_decisions_count; publish the results again to retry it). Every proposal of the round must have a decision. What happens to those that have none follows the round's undecided_at_round_completion, or else the call's: refuse (the refusal carries undecided_count) or reject each at its current step, listed in rejected_proposals. A rejection that fails is listed in failed_proposals and the round stays open; completing again retries it.

    Complete workflow step

    Complete a call step -- named by step_uuid or its key -- with one outcome for every proposal of the round where that step is active, each as if completed on the proposal: same gates, notifications and ledger. Each proposal is committed on its own: one whose step cannot be completed, for whatever reason, is rolled back alone and listed in failed with the reason, and the rest of the round goes on. Proposals not at the step are listed in skipped. Running it again changes nothing for proposals already completed. The allocation decision is refused: it is completed on each proposal. Feedback per proposal is stored as its outcome reason for the step; on a step whose report is released to the applicant it is withheld until then, as when the step is completed on the proposal.

    The call's managers complete any step for a round; the completer of a round step completes it for the proposals of the round they act on.

    Open workflow step

    Open a step run once per round (round_scoped) for the round, named by step_uuid or its key. Refused while a proposal of the round under evaluation has not reached the step yet, unless forced with a reason; that refusal carries lagging_count. The proposals parked on the step before it, waiting to be moved on, are moved into it, each committed on its own and listed in advanced, skipped or failed. Each contributor of the step gets a round report covering the proposals they hold it for, and one mail; the call's managers get one. due_at sets when the step is due in the round. Running it again moves in proposals that arrived meanwhile and changes nothing else.

    Record adoption

    Record that the round's results were adopted: the date, a note and optionally the adopting document. A call with adoption_required takes it only while the round is deciding, and publishes the round's results only once it is recorded. While the round withholds its results, only those who may read the adoption record may write it.

    Run the call's saved scenarios

    Dry-run each scenario of the template the call was created from on the call, at most 20, in the background, and keep the results on the call's latest workflow version; a run already on its way is not started again. Answers at once with the results so far and status 'running': poll workflow-scenarios until its status is 'idle' again. Each run is rolled back: nothing is kept or sent. Results are not kept when another dry run of the call got in the way; 'error' then says so. For those who configure the call, and staff.

    Dry-run the call's workflow

    Replay a path through the call's workflow on a synthetic proposal and return the state of every step, the log, every mail the path would send rendered with the real templates, and the outcomes tried. Stateless: each request replays its whole list of actions, and rewinding is a shorter list. Nothing is sent or kept: the run is rolled back. With view_as, the proposal as a role of the workflow description would read it, through the real read endpoints, as a synthetic holder of that role. For those who configure the call, and staff; one run per call at a time.

    Name Type Required
    uuid string (uuid) ✓
    Field Type Required Description
    key string Identifier of the step within its call. Derived from the name when left out. Cannot change once the step exists.
    step string Deprecated alias of key.
    kind any Behavior of the step; see the workflow_step_kinds endpoint. Required unless the key is one of the default steps. Cannot change once the step exists.
    name string
    description string
    order integer Position in the call's workflow. A step already there, and every step after it, moves one down. Appended when left out.
    outcome_set any Outcomes the step can be completed with; one of its kind's outcome sets. The kind's default when left out.
    on_negative any What a negative outcome does to the proposal.
    is_enabled boolean Whether this step is enabled. Disabled steps are skipped.
    is_allocation_decision boolean The decision step that settles the award. A call is activated with exactly one enabled.
    duration_in_days integer Duration in days. Used to calculate deadlines.
    checklist string (uuid)
    checklist_required boolean When the step has a checklist, block completion until its required questions are answered. Set False to make the checklist advisory.
    blind_review boolean Evaluators cannot see each other's assessments.
    requires_coi_confirmation boolean Evaluator must confirm absence of conflict of interest.
    coi_declaration_text string The conflict-of-interest declaration this step's evaluators confirm; empty for the call's, or the platform's standard one.
    contributor_source string Who contributes to the step, each with a contribution of their own: none, requested_offering_team, assigned_reviewers, proposal_role: or call_role:<call_manager
    per_requested_offering boolean One contribution per offering the proposal requests, which any member of that offering's team may fill.
    contributors_lead_only boolean Only the lead of the evaluator role the contributor source names contributes: one slot, the lead's, which moves when the lead changes. The step waits while the role has no lead.
    delegable_to string Who a contribution slot of the step can be handed to by its holder or the call's managers: empty for nobody, offering_team for anyone with a role on the slot's own offering (per-offering steps), or proposal_role: for the holders of an evaluator role on the proposal (per-person steps). The person it is handed to accepts or declines it.
    min_contributions integer Minimum contributions submitted before the step can complete. On a step without contributors, the minimum of the proposal's submitted reviews.
    max_contributions integer Most contributions the step accepts; no limit when empty.
    min_reviewers integer Deprecated alias of min_contributions.
    min_score_threshold string (decimal) Minimum average score required before this step can complete with any outcome but declined (a completion gate; it does not auto-reject lower scores). A step with contributors scores its own submitted reviews. A step without contributors that reads input steps takes the score of the latest completed input step that has one: the average of its reviews, else of the rating answers in its checklists. Otherwise all the proposal's submitted reviews count.
    applicant_visible boolean Whether the applicant can see step details (not just status).
    completer any Role expected to complete this step.
    responsible_role any Deprecated alias of completer.
    completer_proposal_role string (uuid) The call's evaluator role whose holders complete the step; required when the completer is proposal_role.
    assigns_roles array of string (uuid)s Assignment step: the call's evaluator roles whose holders the completer picks, such as a lead and a second rapporteur.
    input_steps array of string (uuid)s Earlier steps of the call whose outputs this step's contributors and completer read; on an applicant step, whose public parts the applicant reads.
    release_to_applicant boolean Assessment step: once completed, its report can be released to the applicant, such as a consolidated report or final feedback.
    collects_reviewer_suggestions boolean Assessment step of evaluator-role holders: each holder may suggest reviewers for the proposal while the step is active. The call's managers turn suggestions into pool invitations.
    allows_change_requests boolean Whoever acts on the step may send the proposal back to the applicant to change the parts they unlock, as often as needed. The proposal stays in review on the step meanwhile. Not for the allocation decision nor an applicant step.
    allows_conditional_acceptance boolean Per-offering assessment: a contribution may accept a requested offering under conditions. Off, it accepts or rejects it.
    transition_mode any How this step advances once a human completes it. 'Automatic' advances to the next step immediately; 'Manual' waits for a separate advance action. Neither auto-decides from review scores.
    run_condition any When the step runs: empty to run on every proposal; the key of an earlier step and the outcomes of it, or of its contributions, on which it runs; or the key of an earlier step and "score_spread_above": the points by which the highest and lowest scores its contributions gave must differ for the step to run. A proposal on which it does not hold skips the step. Fixed for a proposal when it is submitted.
    parallel_with_previous boolean Start together with the step before it, as one stage: every step of a stage starts at once, and the next stage starts when all of them have ended.
    round_scoped boolean Run the step once per round rather than per proposal, such as a panel meeting after the cut-off: the call's managers open it for the round's proposals together, its contributors write one round report each covering their proposals, and it is completed for the round, never on one proposal.
    phase any When the step runs: in the evaluation, from submission to the award; in an extension, which the applicant of an accepted proposal asks for as often as needed; or in the closing, the final report at the end of the allocation. A phase's steps run in their order, each extension and closing in a run of its own.
    project_end_offset_days integer First step of an extension or closing phase: days before the project's end date. An extension can be asked for until then; the closing opens then (0: on the end date).
    status_labels any What each audience's dashboard calls the step, as entered: per audience, while active, once completed, per outcome and while changes are requested. Left out, the computed label stays.
    include_award_response boolean Allocation decision: require applicant award response after decision.
    decides_automatically boolean Allocation decision: approve on reaching this step, as the system, with the award as requested; fall back to the completer when the approval is refused.
    automatic_decision_guard any Automatic decision: what stops an unsuitable proposal -- an enabled earlier step that can reject it (earlier_step), or a person at the provider acting on every order the award places, on every accepted offering of the call (provider_fulfilment).
    allocation_time any Allocation decision: when a granted proposal takes effect — immediately (on_decision) or on the round's allocation date (fixed_date).
    display_order integer Deprecated: steps are ordered by order.
    criteria array of objects
    criteria.name string ✓
    criteria.order integer
    criteria.weight integer The criterion's weight in a review's overall score, relative to the other criteria of the step.

    run_condition any When the step runs: empty to run on every proposal; the key of an earlier step and the outcomes of it, or of its contributions, on which it runs; or the key of an earlier step and "score_spread_above": the points by which the highest and lowest scores its contributions gave must differ for the step to run. A proposal on which it does not hold skips the step. Fixed for a proposal when it is submitted.
    run_condition_step_name string Name of the step the run condition names, for display; null without a condition.
    parallel_with_previous boolean Start together with the step before it, as one stage: every step of a stage starts at once, and the next stage starts when all of them have ended.
    round_scoped boolean Run the step once per round rather than per proposal, such as a panel meeting after the cut-off: the call's managers open it for the round's proposals together, its contributors write one round report each covering their proposals, and it is completed for the round, never on one proposal.
    phase any When the step runs: in the evaluation, from submission to the award; in an extension, which the applicant of an accepted proposal asks for as often as needed; or in the closing, the final report at the end of the allocation. A phase's steps run in their order, each extension and closing in a run of its own.
    project_end_offset_days integer First step of an extension or closing phase: days before the project's end date. An extension can be asked for until then; the closing opens then (0: on the end date).
    status_labels any What each audience's dashboard calls the step, as entered: per audience, while active, once completed, per outcome and while changes are requested. Left out, the computed label stays.
    include_award_response boolean Allocation decision: require applicant award response after decision.
    decides_automatically boolean Allocation decision: approve on reaching this step, as the system, with the award as requested; fall back to the completer when the approval is refused.
    automatic_decision_guard any Automatic decision: what stops an unsuitable proposal -- an enabled earlier step that can reject it (earlier_step), or a person at the provider acting on every order the award places, on every accepted offering of the call (provider_fulfilment).
    allocation_time any Allocation decision: when a granted proposal takes effect — immediately (on_decision) or on the round's allocation date (fixed_date).
    display_order integer Deprecated: steps are ordered by order.
    criteria array of objects
    criteria.uuid string (uuid)
    criteria.name string
    criteria.order integer
    criteria.weight integer The criterion's weight in a review's overall score, relative to the other criteria of the step.
    criteria_locked boolean Whether reviewers have scored the step's criteria or submitted a review in it. Its criteria can then be reordered, not changed.
    notification_rules array of objects
    notification_rules.uuid string (uuid)
    notification_rules.trigger any
    notification_rules.recipient any
    notification_rules.days_before integer Only for deadline_approaching: how many days before the step's deadline the reminder is sent.
    notification_rules.is_enabled boolean
    notification_rules.notified_proposal_roles array of strings
    notification_rules.proposal_role string (uuid)
    notification_rules.proposal_role_name string

    Name Type Required
    obj_uuid string ✓
    uuid string ✓
    Field Type Required Description
    key string Identifier of the step within its call. Derived from the name when left out. Cannot change once the step exists.
    step string Deprecated alias of key.
    kind any Behavior of the step; see the workflow_step_kinds endpoint. Required unless the key is one of the default steps. Cannot change once the step exists.
    name string
    description string
    order integer Position in the call's workflow. A step already there, and every step after it, moves one down. Appended when left out.
    outcome_set any Outcomes the step can be completed with; one of its kind's outcome sets. The kind's default when left out.
    on_negative any What a negative outcome does to the proposal.
    is_enabled boolean Whether this step is enabled. Disabled steps are skipped.
    is_allocation_decision boolean The decision step that settles the award. A call is activated with exactly one enabled.
    duration_in_days integer Duration in days. Used to calculate deadlines.
    checklist string (uuid)
    checklist_required boolean When the step has a checklist, block completion until its required questions are answered. Set False to make the checklist advisory.
    blind_review boolean Evaluators cannot see each other's assessments.
    requires_coi_confirmation boolean Evaluator must confirm absence of conflict of interest.
    coi_declaration_text string The conflict-of-interest declaration this step's evaluators confirm; empty for the call's, or the platform's standard one.
    contributor_source string Who contributes to the step, each with a contribution of their own: none, requested_offering_team, assigned_reviewers, proposal_role: or call_role:<call_manager
    per_requested_offering boolean One contribution per offering the proposal requests, which any member of that offering's team may fill.
    contributors_lead_only boolean Only the lead of the evaluator role the contributor source names contributes: one slot, the lead's, which moves when the lead changes. The step waits while the role has no lead.
    delegable_to string Who a contribution slot of the step can be handed to by its holder or the call's managers: empty for nobody, offering_team for anyone with a role on the slot's own offering (per-offering steps), or proposal_role: for the holders of an evaluator role on the proposal (per-person steps). The person it is handed to accepts or declines it.
    min_contributions integer Minimum contributions submitted before the step can complete. On a step without contributors, the minimum of the proposal's submitted reviews.
    max_contributions integer Most contributions the step accepts; no limit when empty.
    min_reviewers integer Deprecated alias of min_contributions.
    min_score_threshold string (decimal) Minimum average score required before this step can complete with any outcome but declined (a completion gate; it does not auto-reject lower scores). A step with contributors scores its own submitted reviews. A step without contributors that reads input steps takes the score of the latest completed input step that has one: the average of its reviews, else of the rating answers in its checklists. Otherwise all the proposal's submitted reviews count.
    applicant_visible boolean Whether the applicant can see step details (not just status).
    completer any Role expected to complete this step.
    responsible_role any Deprecated alias of completer.
    completer_proposal_role string (uuid) The call's evaluator role whose holders complete the step; required when the completer is proposal_role.
    assigns_roles array of string (uuid)s Assignment step: the call's evaluator roles whose holders the completer picks, such as a lead and a second rapporteur.
    input_steps array of string (uuid)s Earlier steps of the call whose outputs this step's contributors and completer read; on an applicant step, whose public parts the applicant reads.
    release_to_applicant boolean Assessment step: once completed, its report can be released to the applicant, such as a consolidated report or final feedback.
    collects_reviewer_suggestions boolean Assessment step of evaluator-role holders: each holder may suggest reviewers for the proposal while the step is active. The call's managers turn suggestions into pool invitations.
    allows_change_requests boolean Whoever acts on the step may send the proposal back to the applicant to change the parts they unlock, as often as needed. The proposal stays in review on the step meanwhile. Not for the allocation decision nor an applicant step.
    allows_conditional_acceptance boolean Per-offering assessment: a contribution may accept a requested offering under conditions. Off, it accepts or rejects it.
    transition_mode any How this step advances once a human completes it. 'Automatic' advances to the next step immediately; 'Manual' waits for a separate advance action. Neither auto-decides from review scores.
    run_condition any When the step runs: empty to run on every proposal; the key of an earlier step and the outcomes of it, or of its contributions, on which it runs; or the key of an earlier step and "score_spread_above": the points by which the highest and lowest scores its contributions gave must differ for the step to run. A proposal on which it does not hold skips the step. Fixed for a proposal when it is submitted.
    parallel_with_previous boolean Start together with the step before it, as one stage: every step of a stage starts at once, and the next stage starts when all of them have ended.
    round_scoped boolean Run the step once per round rather than per proposal, such as a panel meeting after the cut-off: the call's managers open it for the round's proposals together, its contributors write one round report each covering their proposals, and it is completed for the round, never on one proposal.
    phase any When the step runs: in the evaluation, from submission to the award; in an extension, which the applicant of an accepted proposal asks for as often as needed; or in the closing, the final report at the end of the allocation. A phase's steps run in their order, each extension and closing in a run of its own.
    project_end_offset_days integer First step of an extension or closing phase: days before the project's end date. An extension can be asked for until then; the closing opens then (0: on the end date).
    status_labels any What each audience's dashboard calls the step, as entered: per audience, while active, once completed, per outcome and while changes are requested. Left out, the computed label stays.
    include_award_response boolean Allocation decision: require applicant award response after decision.
    decides_automatically boolean Allocation decision: approve on reaching this step, as the system, with the award as requested; fall back to the completer when the approval is refused.
    automatic_decision_guard any Automatic decision: what stops an unsuitable proposal -- an enabled earlier step that can reject it (earlier_step), or a person at the provider acting on every order the award places, on every accepted offering of the call (provider_fulfilment).
    allocation_time any Allocation decision: when a granted proposal takes effect — immediately (on_decision) or on the round's allocation date (fixed_date).
    display_order integer Deprecated: steps are ordered by order.
    criteria array of objects
    criteria.name string ✓
    criteria.order integer
    criteria.weight integer The criterion's weight in a review's overall score, relative to the other criteria of the step.

    allows_conditional_acceptance boolean Per-offering assessment: a contribution may accept a requested offering under conditions. Off, it accepts or rejects it.
    transition_mode any How this step advances once a human completes it. 'Automatic' advances to the next step immediately; 'Manual' waits for a separate advance action. Neither auto-decides from review scores.
    run_condition any When the step runs: empty to run on every proposal; the key of an earlier step and the outcomes of it, or of its contributions, on which it runs; or the key of an earlier step and "score_spread_above": the points by which the highest and lowest scores its contributions gave must differ for the step to run. A proposal on which it does not hold skips the step. Fixed for a proposal when it is submitted.
    run_condition_step_name string Name of the step the run condition names, for display; null without a condition.
    parallel_with_previous boolean Start together with the step before it, as one stage: every step of a stage starts at once, and the next stage starts when all of them have ended.
    round_scoped boolean Run the step once per round rather than per proposal, such as a panel meeting after the cut-off: the call's managers open it for the round's proposals together, its contributors write one round report each covering their proposals, and it is completed for the round, never on one proposal.
    phase any When the step runs: in the evaluation, from submission to the award; in an extension, which the applicant of an accepted proposal asks for as often as needed; or in the closing, the final report at the end of the allocation. A phase's steps run in their order, each extension and closing in a run of its own.
    project_end_offset_days integer First step of an extension or closing phase: days before the project's end date. An extension can be asked for until then; the closing opens then (0: on the end date).
    status_labels any What each audience's dashboard calls the step, as entered: per audience, while active, once completed, per outcome and while changes are requested. Left out, the computed label stays.
    include_award_response boolean Allocation decision: require applicant award response after decision.
    decides_automatically boolean Allocation decision: approve on reaching this step, as the system, with the award as requested; fall back to the completer when the approval is refused.
    automatic_decision_guard any Automatic decision: what stops an unsuitable proposal -- an enabled earlier step that can reject it (earlier_step), or a person at the provider acting on every order the award places, on every accepted offering of the call (provider_fulfilment).
    allocation_time any Allocation decision: when a granted proposal takes effect — immediately (on_decision) or on the round's allocation date (fixed_date).
    display_order integer Deprecated: steps are ordered by order.
    criteria array of objects
    criteria.uuid string (uuid)
    criteria.name string
    criteria.order integer
    criteria.weight integer The criterion's weight in a review's overall score, relative to the other criteria of the step.
    criteria_locked boolean Whether reviewers have scored the step's criteria or submitted a review in it. Its criteria can then be reordered, not changed.
    notification_rules array of objects
    notification_rules.uuid string (uuid)
    notification_rules.trigger any
    notification_rules.recipient any
    notification_rules.days_before integer Only for deadline_approaching: how many days before the step's deadline the reminder is sent.
    notification_rules.is_enabled boolean
    notification_rules.notified_proposal_roles array of strings
    notification_rules.proposal_role string (uuid)
    notification_rules.proposal_role_name string

    Name Type Required

    Field Type Required Description
    name string
    description string
    order integer Position in the call's workflow. A step already there, and every step after it, moves one down. Appended when left out.
    outcome_set any Outcomes the step can be completed with; one of its kind's outcome sets. The kind's default when left out.
    on_negative any What a negative outcome does to the proposal.
    is_enabled boolean Whether this step is enabled. Disabled steps are skipped.
    is_allocation_decision boolean The decision step that settles the award. A call is activated with exactly one enabled.
    duration_in_days integer Duration in days. Used to calculate deadlines.
    checklist string (uuid)
    checklist_required boolean When the step has a checklist, block completion until its required questions are answered. Set False to make the checklist advisory.
    blind_review boolean Evaluators cannot see each other's assessments.
    requires_coi_confirmation boolean Evaluator must confirm absence of conflict of interest.
    coi_declaration_text string The conflict-of-interest declaration this step's evaluators confirm; empty for the call's, or the platform's standard one.
    contributor_source string Who contributes to the step, each with a contribution of their own: none, requested_offering_team, assigned_reviewers, proposal_role: or call_role:<call_manager
    per_requested_offering boolean One contribution per offering the proposal requests, which any member of that offering's team may fill.
    contributors_lead_only boolean Only the lead of the evaluator role the contributor source names contributes: one slot, the lead's, which moves when the lead changes. The step waits while the role has no lead.
    delegable_to string Who a contribution slot of the step can be handed to by its holder or the call's managers: empty for nobody, offering_team for anyone with a role on the slot's own offering (per-offering steps), or proposal_role: for the holders of an evaluator role on the proposal (per-person steps). The person it is handed to accepts or declines it.
    min_contributions integer Minimum contributions submitted before the step can complete. On a step without contributors, the minimum of the proposal's submitted reviews.
    max_contributions integer Most contributions the step accepts; no limit when empty.
    min_reviewers integer Deprecated alias of min_contributions.
    min_score_threshold string (decimal) Minimum average score required before this step can complete with any outcome but declined (a completion gate; it does not auto-reject lower scores). A step with contributors scores its own submitted reviews. A step without contributors that reads input steps takes the score of the latest completed input step that has one: the average of its reviews, else of the rating answers in its checklists. Otherwise all the proposal's submitted reviews count.
    applicant_visible boolean Whether the applicant can see step details (not just status).
    completer any Role expected to complete this step.
    responsible_role any Deprecated alias of completer.
    completer_proposal_role string (uuid) The call's evaluator role whose holders complete the step; required when the completer is proposal_role.
    assigns_roles array of string (uuid)s Assignment step: the call's evaluator roles whose holders the completer picks, such as a lead and a second rapporteur.
    input_steps array of string (uuid)s Earlier steps of the call whose outputs this step's contributors and completer read; on an applicant step, whose public parts the applicant reads.
    release_to_applicant boolean Assessment step: once completed, its report can be released to the applicant, such as a consolidated report or final feedback.
    collects_reviewer_suggestions boolean Assessment step of evaluator-role holders: each holder may suggest reviewers for the proposal while the step is active. The call's managers turn suggestions into pool invitations.
    allows_change_requests boolean Whoever acts on the step may send the proposal back to the applicant to change the parts they unlock, as often as needed. The proposal stays in review on the step meanwhile. Not for the allocation decision nor an applicant step.
    allows_conditional_acceptance boolean Per-offering assessment: a contribution may accept a requested offering under conditions. Off, it accepts or rejects it.
    transition_mode any How this step advances once a human completes it. 'Automatic' advances to the next step immediately; 'Manual' waits for a separate advance action. Neither auto-decides from review scores.
    run_condition any When the step runs: empty to run on every proposal; the key of an earlier step and the outcomes of it, or of its contributions, on which it runs; or the key of an earlier step and "score_spread_above": the points by which the highest and lowest scores its contributions gave must differ for the step to run. A proposal on which it does not hold skips the step. Fixed for a proposal when it is submitted.
    parallel_with_previous boolean Start together with the step before it, as one stage: every step of a stage starts at once, and the next stage starts when all of them have ended.
    round_scoped boolean Run the step once per round rather than per proposal, such as a panel meeting after the cut-off: the call's managers open it for the round's proposals together, its contributors write one round report each covering their proposals, and it is completed for the round, never on one proposal.
    phase any When the step runs: in the evaluation, from submission to the award; in an extension, which the applicant of an accepted proposal asks for as often as needed; or in the closing, the final report at the end of the allocation. A phase's steps run in their order, each extension and closing in a run of its own.
    project_end_offset_days integer First step of an extension or closing phase: days before the project's end date. An extension can be asked for until then; the closing opens then (0: on the end date).
    status_labels any What each audience's dashboard calls the step, as entered: per audience, while active, once completed, per outcome and while changes are requested. Left out, the computed label stays.
    include_award_response boolean Allocation decision: require applicant award response after decision.
    decides_automatically boolean Allocation decision: approve on reaching this step, as the system, with the award as requested; fall back to the completer when the approval is refused.
    automatic_decision_guard any Automatic decision: what stops an unsuitable proposal -- an enabled earlier step that can reject it (earlier_step), or a person at the provider acting on every order the award places, on every accepted offering of the call (provider_fulfilment).
    allocation_time any Allocation decision: when a granted proposal takes effect — immediately (on_decision) or on the round's allocation date (fixed_date).
    display_order integer Deprecated: steps are ordered by order.
    criteria array of objects
    criteria.name string ✓
    criteria.order integer
    criteria.weight integer The criterion's weight in a review's overall score, relative to the other criteria of the step.

Day and week need the integration to report usage per day. Empty when customers cannot set spending limits.
    requested_offering_components.factor integer
    requested_offering_components.is_builtin boolean The API's older name for billed_per_plan. It used to ask the plugin registry whether this component's type is one the plugin declares, which left out the OpenStack per-volume-type quotas: they are created by the volume type sync rather than declared, so the API called them provider components while the billing resolver treated them as builtin. Reading the stored flag makes the two agree.
    requested_offering_components.is_prepaid boolean
    requested_offering_components.overage_component string (uuid)
    requested_offering_components.min_prepaid_duration integer
    requested_offering_components.max_prepaid_duration integer
    requested_offering_components.prepaid_duration_step integer Step size in months for the initial prepaid duration at order creation. If set, only multiples of this value (starting from min_prepaid_duration) are valid. Defaults to 1 (any value between min and max).
    requested_offering_components.min_renewal_duration integer Minimum number of months allowed for a renewal.
    requested_offering_components.max_renewal_duration integer Maximum number of months allowed for a renewal.
    requested_offering_components.renewal_duration_step integer Step size in months for renewal. Only multiples of this value (starting from min_renewal_duration) are valid. Defaults to 1.

    created_by_name string

    Field Type Description
    uuid string (uuid)

    start_time string (date-time)
    cutoff_time string (date-time) When submission closes. Empty: the round stays open until a call manager closes it.
    status any
    allocation_date string (date-time)
    review_duration_in_days integer Deprecated: a review is due when the step it contributes to is (see the round's step due dates). Only a review whose step has no deadline is still due this many days after it was created.
    lifecycle_state any Where the round stands after its cut-off: evaluating, deciding, results_published or closed. Empty before the cut-off.
    evaluation_started_at string (date-time)

    proposals array of objects
    proposals.uuid string (uuid)
    proposals.slug string
    proposals.name string
    proposals.state any
    proposals.reviews array of anys Return serialized reviews based on user permissions and visibility settings. - Staff, call managers, and reviewers see all reviews. - Submitters see submitted reviews if visibility is enabled.
    proposals.approved_by_name string
    proposals.created_by_name string
    proposals.created string (date-time)
    results_published_by_name string
    held_decisions_count integer Proposals of the round whose decision is recorded but not yet published. After publication, decisions that could not be carried out; publishing the results again retries them. Null for anyone who may not see held decisions.
    has_proposals boolean Whether the round holds any proposal, in any state. A round with proposals cannot be deleted. Unlike the proposals list, which leaves out what the viewer may not see, this counts every one.
    round_steps array of objects The call's enabled steps in this round: the due date of each there, how many proposals stand before, at and parked on it, and for a step run once per round its opening and round reports.
    round_steps.step_uuid string (uuid)
    round_steps.step_key string

    round_steps.step_kind string
    round_steps.order integer
    round_steps.round_scoped boolean

    round_steps.opened_at string (date-time)
    round_steps.proposals_at_step integer Proposals of the round standing at the step now.
    round_steps.proposals_before_step integer Proposals of the round still to reach the step.
    round_steps.proposals_awaiting_advance integer Proposals parked on the step once completed, waiting to be moved on.
    round_steps.reports_total integer
    round_steps.reports_submitted integer
    results_forced_reason string Why results were published while some proposals of the round still had no decision.
    adoption_note string
    adoption_document string (uri)
    undecided_at_round_completion any Overrides the call's rule for proposals still without a decision when the round is completed. Empty: the call's rule applies.

    Name Type Required
    obj_uuid string ✓
    uuid string ✓

    200 -

    Field Type Description
    uuid string (uuid)
    created string (date-time)
    modified string (date-time)
    key string Identifier of the step within its call. Derived from the name when left out. Cannot change once the step exists.
    step string Deprecated alias of key.
    kind any Behavior of the step; see the workflow_step_kinds endpoint. Required unless the key is one of the default steps. Cannot change once the step exists.
    name string
    description string
    order integer Position in the call's workflow. A step already there, and every step after it, moves one down. Appended when left out.
    outcome_set any Outcomes the step can be completed with; one of its kind's outcome sets. The kind's default when left out.
    allowed_outcomes array of strings Outcomes the step can be completed with.
    on_negative any What a negative outcome does to the proposal.
    call_uuid string (uuid)
    call_name string
    is_enabled boolean Whether this step is enabled. Disabled steps are skipped.
    is_mandatory boolean
    is_allocation_decision boolean The decision step that settles the award. A call is activated with exactly one enabled.
    duration_in_days integer Duration in days. Used to calculate deadlines.
    checklist string (uuid)
    checklist_name string
    checklist_required boolean When the step has a checklist, block completion until its required questions are answered. Set False to make the checklist advisory.
    blind_review boolean Evaluators cannot see each other's assessments.
    requires_coi_confirmation boolean Evaluator must confirm absence of conflict of interest.
    coi_declaration_text string The conflict-of-interest declaration this step's evaluators confirm; empty for the call's, or the platform's standard one.
    contributor_source string Who contributes to the step, each with a contribution of their own: none, requested_offering_team, assigned_reviewers, proposal_role: or call_role:<call_manager
    contributor_proposal_role_uuid string (uuid) The evaluator role the contributor source names, when it names one.
    delegable_proposal_role_uuid string (uuid) The evaluator role delegable_to names, when it names one: its holders on the proposal can be handed a slot.
    per_requested_offering boolean One contribution per offering the proposal requests, which any member of that offering's team may fill.
    contributors_lead_only boolean Only the lead of the evaluator role the contributor source names contributes: one slot, the lead's, which moves when the lead changes. The step waits while the role has no lead.
    delegable_to string Who a contribution slot of the step can be handed to by its holder or the call's managers: empty for nobody, offering_team for anyone with a role on the slot's own offering (per-offering steps), or proposal_role: for the holders of an evaluator role on the proposal (per-person steps). The person it is handed to accepts or declines it.
    min_contributions integer Minimum contributions submitted before the step can complete. On a step without contributors, the minimum of the proposal's submitted reviews.
    max_contributions integer Most contributions the step accepts; no limit when empty.
    min_reviewers integer Deprecated alias of min_contributions.
    min_score_threshold string (decimal) Minimum average score required before this step can complete with any outcome but declined (a completion gate; it does not auto-reject lower scores). A step with contributors scores its own submitted reviews. A step without contributors that reads input steps takes the score of the latest completed input step that has one: the average of its reviews, else of the rating answers in its checklists. Otherwise all the proposal's submitted reviews count.
    applicant_visible boolean Whether the applicant can see step details (not just status).
    completer any Role expected to complete this step.
    responsible_role any Deprecated alias of completer.
    completer_proposal_role string (uuid) The call's evaluator role whose holders complete the step; required when the completer is proposal_role.
    completer_proposal_role_name string
    assigns_roles array of string (uuid)s Assignment step: the call's evaluator roles whose holders the completer picks, such as a lead and a second rapporteur.
    assigns_roles_names array of strings
    input_steps array of string (uuid)s Earlier steps of the call whose outputs this step's contributors and completer read; on an applicant step, whose public parts the applicant reads.
    input_steps_names array of strings
    contributors_warning string Why the call cannot give the step the contributions it needs: the evaluator role, call role or reviewer pool it takes them from has fewer people than its minimum. Null when it can.
    release_to_applicant boolean Assessment step: once completed, its report can be released to the applicant, such as a consolidated report or final feedback.
    collects_reviewer_suggestions boolean Assessment step of evaluator-role holders: each holder may suggest reviewers for the proposal while the step is active. The call's managers turn suggestions into pool invitations.
    allows_change_requests boolean Whoever acts on the step may send the proposal back to the applicant to change the parts they unlock, as often as needed. The proposal stays in review on the step meanwhile. Not for the allocation decision nor an applicant step.
    allows_conditional_acceptance boolean Per-offering assessment: a contribution may accept a requested offering under conditions. Off, it accepts or rejects it.
    transition_mode any How this step advances once a human completes it. 'Automatic' advances to the next step immediately; 'Manual' waits for a separate advance action. Neither auto-decides from review scores.
    run_condition any When the step runs: empty to run on every proposal; the key of an earlier step and the outcomes of it, or of its contributions, on which it runs; or the key of an earlier step and "score_spread_above": the points by which the highest and lowest scores its contributions gave must differ for the step to run. A proposal on which it does not hold skips the step. Fixed for a proposal when it is submitted.
    run_condition_step_name string Name of the step the run condition names, for display; null without a condition.
    parallel_with_previous boolean Start together with the step before it, as one stage: every step of a stage starts at once, and the next stage starts when all of them have ended.
    round_scoped boolean Run the step once per round rather than per proposal, such as a panel meeting after the cut-off: the call's managers open it for the round's proposals together, its contributors write one round report each covering their proposals, and it is completed for the round, never on one proposal.
    phase any When the step runs: in the evaluation, from submission to the award; in an extension, which the applicant of an accepted proposal asks for as often as needed; or in the closing, the final report at the end of the allocation. A phase's steps run in their order, each extension and closing in a run of its own.
    project_end_offset_days integer First step of an extension or closing phase: days before the project's end date. An extension can be asked for until then; the closing opens then (0: on the end date).
    status_labels any What each audience's dashboard calls the step, as entered: per audience, while active, once completed, per outcome and while changes are requested. Left out, the computed label stays.
    include_award_response boolean Allocation decision: require applicant award response after decision.
    decides_automatically boolean Allocation decision: approve on reaching this step, as the system, with the award as requested; fall back to the completer when the approval is refused.
    automatic_decision_guard any Automatic decision: what stops an unsuitable proposal -- an enabled earlier step that can reject it (earlier_step), or a person at the provider acting on every order the award places, on every accepted offering of the call (provider_fulfilment).
    allocation_time any Allocation decision: when a granted proposal takes effect — immediately (on_decision) or on the round's allocation date (fixed_date).
    display_order integer Deprecated: steps are ordered by order.
    criteria array of objects
    criteria.uuid string (uuid)
    criteria.name string
    criteria.order integer
    criteria.weight integer The criterion's weight in a review's overall score, relative to the other criteria of the step.
    criteria_locked boolean Whether reviewers have scored the step's criteria or submitted a review in it. Its criteria can then be reordered, not changed.
    notification_rules array of objects
    notification_rules.uuid string (uuid)
    notification_rules.trigger any
    notification_rules.recipient any
    notification_rules.days_before integer Only for deadline_approaching: how many days before the step's deadline the reminder is sent.
    notification_rules.is_enabled boolean
    notification_rules.notified_proposal_roles array of strings
    notification_rules.proposal_role string (uuid)
    notification_rules.proposal_role_name string
    responsible_users array of objects
    responsible_users.uuid string (uuid)
    responsible_users.username string
    responsible_users.full_name string
    responsible_users.email string (email)
    responsible_users.is_panel_chair boolean
    responsible_users.is_panel_vice_chair boolean
    responsible_users.offerings array of objects The offerings accepted into the call that the user manages; empty unless the user takes part as an offering manager.
    responsible_users.offerings.uuid string (uuid)
    responsible_users.offerings.name string
    responsible_users.offerings.customer_uuid string (uuid)
    contributing_users array of objects Who the contributor source names on the call: the holders of the call role it names, the reviewers who accepted to join the reviewer pool, or the managers of the offerings accepted into the call. Empty for an evaluator role, which is held per proposal.
    contributing_users.uuid string (uuid)
    contributing_users.username string
    contributing_users.full_name string
    contributing_users.email string (email)
    contributing_users.is_panel_chair boolean
    contributing_users.is_panel_vice_chair boolean
    contributing_users.offerings array of objects The offerings accepted into the call that the user manages; empty unless the user takes part as an offering manager.
    contributing_users.offerings.uuid string (uuid)
    contributing_users.offerings.name string
    contributing_users.offerings.customer_uuid string (uuid)
